name: Covered tankard with loop handle
dimensions:
H. 19 x Diam. 12.5 cm (7 1/2 x 4 15/16 in.)
across handles: W. 14.6 cm (5 3/4 in.)
summary: Covered metal-form tankard with loop handle; decorative flange above the loop handle to support a thumb; domed cover with knob in the form of a pointed lotus bud; gray earthenware with lead-fluxed emerald-green glaze.
